texto: Low-angle wide shot at golden hour: endless wheat fields of Westfall, a creaking windmill and a broken fence; the warrior walks out of the shimmering heat haze on a dusty road, sword on his back, wind in his hair. On the porch of a red-roofed farmhouse, Salma hands the warrior a long rolled parchment scroll; he unrolls it, it drops to the floor, and he looks into the camera with an exaggerated confident grin.

texto: On a rocky hill under a hard sun, the warrior swings his huge sword at the stop-motion vulture, which hops aside in jerky frame-by-frame motion and pecks the top of his head. The dishevelled warrior, feathers stuck in his hair, proudly holds up a tiny scrawny drumstick while a single grey feather drifts down in front of his face.

texto: In dry golden grass, the plush felt boar paws the ground and charges in jerky stop-motion straight at the warrior, who plants his feet and raises his sword. The dazed warrior sits in the grass with his hair standing up, holding a big pink felt boar snout like a trophy, while the plush boar trots away offended, now with a little cloth bandage on its face. No blood.

texto: A rocky coast at sunset beside a half-sunken wooden shipwreck: three glossy claymation murlocs rise from the foamy surf in stop-motion, gurgling, fin crests flaring. The warrior lies on the wet sand buried under a wriggling pile of small claymation murlocs, one arm sticking out, triumphantly holding up a small glass jar with a glowing round murloc eye inside.

texto: Night, a field of tall okra plants under a huge full moon: the warrior tiptoes between the plants filling a burlap sack with green okra pods, looking over his shoulder. Behind the frozen warrior, the harvest watcher animatronic rises slowly from the field with creaking rusty joints, straw falling from its body, raising its scythe hands against the moonlight.

texto: Moonlit chase: the warrior sprints through the okra field clutching his sack while the harvest watcher stomps after him in stop-motion, scythes slicing plants, straw and leaves flying. Inside the warm farmhouse lit by a crackling fireplace, the battered warrior slams the sack, the drumstick, the snout and the jar on a wooden table; Salma inspects each item, unimpressed.

texto: Salma tips everything into the bubbling cauldron over the fire; the warrior, exhausted and smiling, lifts a wooden spoon of stew to his mouth. Close-up of the cauldron: a small glossy claymation creature made of stew and okra rises out of the broth and blinks at the warrior, who freezes with the spoon at his lips, eyes wide.
